basic_profile.bio: I'm a 31-year-old software developer from Mumbai, India. By day, I work as a freelance web developer, focusing primarily on front-end technologies. In my free time, I enjoy exploring new tech gadgets, particularly laptops, and I'm an avid follower of K-pop, especially Enhypen. I usually spend my evenings online after work hours, often browsing tech forums and indulging in some casual gaming. Currently single, I appreciate the freedom to pursue my hobbies and interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Computer Science and over six years of industry experience, I've developed a strong foundation in coding and technology. I keep myself updated through tech blogs, forums, and by experimenting with new software and hardware.
